title: Scandinavian flick
about: A feint away from the corner loads the outside of the car; turning in hard with a touch of brake then swings the rear into the corner, and the slide is caught and driven out. Drafted by Claude from general rally-driving knowledge in its own words (docs/DRIVER.md); not yet checked against coaching sources or reviewed by the owner. Each phase's cue is shown while Watch AI drives it, and its mark labels it on the input trace (ADR 0015).

lines.about: The line the runner follows, per drill, in the course frame (x right, y ahead of the venue start, metres): what the dials were tuned on. tools/driver/attempt.py line C08 prints it again from tools/ingame/lines.py.

humanLimits.reactionAppliesTo: corrections only (the catch's counter-steer, stage 2's correction): rehearsed phase changes fire at once (owner, 2026-11-01)

phases.cue: Settle the speed and line before the Flick gate
phases.endsWhen: the car is feintAfterM past the Flick gate

phases.cue: Lift and flick away from the corner
phases.endsWhen: the car has turned feintYawDeg away from the corner, after feintMinS; or feintMaxS
phases.reward: lateral acceleration towards the outside of the corner: the weight has moved there

phases.cue: Turn in hard with a touch of brake
phases.endsWhen: the feint's swing away has slowed to loadUnwindDegS (yaw rate), after loadMinS; or loadMaxS. The rear comes round into the corner after this, during the catch
phases.reward: rear slip angle into the corner beyond the medal target (8 / 12 / 15 degrees)

phases.cue: Catch the slide, eyes on the exit
phases.endsWhen: the slip angle is below settleSlipDeg after 0.3 s, or catchMaxS
phases.reward: clearance to the posts; no spin

phases.cue: Throttle on, out through the Exit gate
phases.endsWhen: 12 m past the Exit gate, then a stop
phases.reward: speed at the Exit gate (25 / 40 / 45 km/h)

faults.if: rear slip below 5 degrees after load_turn_in
faults.cue: Commit harder: more brake as you turn in
Catch it sooner: counter-steer as soon as the rear goes

faults.if: turned in more than 1.5 s after the feint
faults.cue: Make it one movement: away, then straight back in
